LGM_LM87: Once a racing pedigree famed for speed and dependability, the superstar LM87 has followed in the footsteps of every cultural icon that didn't have the good sense to die: retiring to LS where it can guzzle Premium, cruise Vinewood Boulevard flashing its taillights, and crash out face first in a Rockford Hills swimming pool.
SSS_KANJOSJ: To the uninitiated, a run-of-the-mill early 2000s compact. But to those with eyes to see, the Kanjo SJ is a ticket back to a simpler time: downing cans of Sprunk in the mall parking lot, checking out each other's neon underbody kits, fingering each other's spoilers, dropping quarter mile brags, and calling your dad when you break down on the way home.
LGM_OMNISEGT: Take a moment for mindfulness. Time to breathe, to reflect, to appreciate life's little joys. Like two AC synchronous electric motors and all-wheel drive. Or why not an optional Missile Lock-On Jammer, Remote Control Unit, Slick Mines, and Armor Plating? Just remember, it's not the number of breaths you take, but the number of mods that take your breath away ... #blessed.~n~~n~- Imani Tech upgrades available (Agency Vehicle Workshop)
SSS_POSTLUDE: Considered the dark horse of Japanese bubble era car design, the Postlude lost out in a history written by the victorious Elegy and its affordable friends. But to those in the know, this was an injustice waiting to be corrected. Across the mod shops and car meets of San Andreas, a select group of artisans and visionaries are still brought together by their shared love of boxy aesthetics and static sunroofs. Make your voice heard. There are literally dozens of you.
LSC_BRIOSO2: Why do you drive a Brioso? For the laughs? For the awws? Or is it for the forced perspective? Yeah, Benny knows your tricks. And he's here to help. Draw attention to all the right places with the Grotti Brioso 300 Widebody. Eligible for customization at Benny's Original Motor Works.
LSC_SENTINEL3: The Sentinel Classic was already the kind of rally-ready blank canvas that mod freaks only get once in a generation. Where to go from there? Only Benny knows... All we know is that it's going to make you say "Of course!" and "What the f*ck?!!" at exactly the same time. Eligible for customization at Benny's Original Motor Works.
LGM_SM722: Are You Bored? Horny? Constipated? Here are 4 easy steps to all-round instant relief. 1) Buy an SM722, the new open-cockpit speedster from Benefactor. 2) Start the engine. 3) Place your foot on the far-right pedal. 4) Twitch... You won't believe what happens at step 5!
LGM_CONADA: "What is a utility helicopter?" we hear you ask. Well, a utility helicopter is like a utility belt, but it weighs over 1.6 tons and was responsible for 131 highly spectacular fatalities last year in Los Santos alone. We'd say you can't buy that kind of convenience – but as of now, you can.
SSS_RUINER4: The millennium bug didn't get you. The war on terror didn't scare you. And the great recession didn't stop you when it came in hot and heavy. The 2000s didn't give us much except disillusionment. But for those who remember, they also gave us the high-performance ZZ-8, the greatest sports car in the Ruiner lineage.
WTD_TACRIFLE: This season's must-have hardware for law enforcement, military personnel and anyone locked in a fight to the death with either law enforcement or military personnel.
LGM_TENF: The air intake slots, the titanium valvetrain, that big, thicc naturally aspirated engine. Yes. This is a thirst post. And let's be honest. It's working. Eligible for customization at Benny's Original Motor Works.~n~~n~- Missile Lock-On Jammer available
SSS_VIGERO2: Want to wield a hunk of muscle that would make the buffest gym bros and lamest ego lifters cry? Forget Bull Shark Testosterone. If you're looking to bulk up, try the Vigero ZX, and enjoy fast gains that won't leave you with nips the size of dinner plates.~n~~n~- HSW upgrades available (LS Car Meet, The Vinewood Club Garage, and Mansion Vehicle Workshops (GTA+))~n~- Missile Lock-On Jammer available
SSS_GREENWOOD: With the potential for a Missile Lock-On Jammer, Remote Control Unit, Slick Mines and Armor Plating, the Bravado Greenwood brings you old-school tastes, old-school muscle, old-school diplomacy, and new-school know-how. So the next time someone asks why you keep buying that same bucket-ass car, you'll be able to fire back with more than a one-liner.~n~~n~- Imani Tech upgrades available (Agency Vehicle Workshop)
SSS_DRAUGUR: If you're on the right side of the hood, it's a rough and ready dream. If you're on the wrong side, it's a titanium-reinforced nightmare. Meet the Draugur, the bare-bones legend with extreme off-road capabilities. Summoned from the darkest corners of Declasse, the Draugur will get you to hell and back without a scratch. Or to your local Cluckin' Bell. Same difference.
SSS_RHINEHART: You're far too cool to own an SUV. And a sedan? You might as well get "practical" and "economical" tattooed on your nuts. No, you're performance-driven. You're an executive. You're a family of four, and not a day goes by that you don't regret it with every fiber of your being. You're already a Rhinehart owner. You just don't know it yet.
LGM_CORSITA: Blood pressure rising? Heart rate increasing? Body temperature comparable to the core of a freshly microwaved pizza pocket? Well, don't panic if you feel the urge to grab a fistful of lotion. These are all the normal symptoms of close contact with the Corsita, the hottest new set of wheels from Lampadati.
LGM_TORERO2: The Pegassi Torero gave you old-school pornstar heat. The XO is something altogether more glamorous. With its powerful angles, edgy lines and ecstatic propulsion, this is the kind of A-Lister who'll break the box office, start a fashion line, squeeze in a developing world photo op, finish up with a full spread in Pussycat Magazine — and stay classy every step of the way.~n~~n~- Missile Lock-On Jammer available

WCT_HVSN_XM4_L: Win Entourage (Festive Remix) as Santa to unlock this finish for purchase
LGM_BALLER8: Got the itch for a supercharged SUV with serious go-power? Then you might have a case of the Gallivanter Baller ST-D. And you wouldn't be the first. The ST-D: Everybody's getting it.~n~~n~- Imani Tech upgrades available (Agency Vehicle Workshop)
FCSALVAGE_REPAIR_DESC: Connections to local businesses are priceless, yet surprisingly affordable. Which is why, for a one-off payment, you'll receive discounts on all claims with Mors Mutual and on repairing vehicles with LS Customs.
FCSALVAGE_SAFE_DESC: Nothing flexes your success like a block of steel and concrete large enough to store up to $250,000. Business development is all about tangible goals.
SSS_FR36: Can you take 4360lbs of sports car around a mountaintop hairpin bend as smoothly as a 30-year-old shut-in caresses his life-size Princess Robot Bubblegum bodypillow? It's an enthusiastic YES YOU CAN from Japan with the oh so driftable Fathom FR36 coupe.~n~~n~- Drift tuning available (LS Car Meet, The Vinewood Club Garage, and Mansion Vehicle Workshops (GTA+))~n~- Missile Lock-On Jammer available
CANDC_BOXVILLE6: There's a million and one reasons why you would want to buy a well-used Los Santos Department of Sanitation van. For example, you work for the Los Santos Department of Sanitation.~n~~n~Please note: This is a Pegasus vehicle and cannot be stored in a personal garage.
SSS_DOMINATOR9: From the makers of the Dominator cult classics comes an all-American, pant-shitting, drop-top 4D experience: The Dominator GT. Why be stimulated when you can be overstimulated, as you drag your sensory cortex over mile after mile of burning asphalt? Taste every victory. Feel every collision. Pay every insurance excess. Domination has a new name.~n~~n~- Drift tuning available (LS Car Meet, The Vinewood Club Garage, and Mansion Vehicle Workshops (GTA+))~n~- Missile Lock-On Jammer available
WCT_CMPT_XM4_L: Complete Entourage (Festive Remix) one time to unlock this finish for purchase
SSS_VIVANITE: Certified MILF mobile of Middle America, the Karin Vivanite is the first word in practical family minivans and the last word in unexpected drag racing. So next time you can't decide between taking the kids to soccer practice and melting the asphalt with a class 1 misdemeanor, remember you can always smash two birds to a pulp with one value-conscious stone.~n~~n~- HSW upgrades available (LS Car Meet, The Vinewood Club Garage, and Mansion Vehicle Workshops (GTA+))
DORAD_BBAR6: Bullbar II w/ Color Fog Covers
LGM_ALEUTIAN: With the cartels and the FIB both purchasing in bulk, the Vapid Aleutian has been the poster child of the war on drugs ever since it rolled off the production line. That's the kind of reliable consumer base that'll put the American car industry back on the map, and with optional Armor Plating, Slick Mines, a Remote Control Unit and Missile Lock-On Jammer, this is a revival you're going to want to be part of.~n~~n~- Imani Tech upgrades available (Agency Vehicle Workshop)
CANDC_PRANGER: People say that members of the San Andreas State Park Rangers aren't real cops. But then, you aren't even a real member of San Andreas State Park Rangers. You're just a concerned citizen with a passion for keeping the Chiliad Mountain State Wilderness free of litter, and a whole lot of backpackers smeared over your hood. But hey, even vigilantes can look the part.~n~~n~Please note: This vehicle has a resale value of $0.
FCSALVAGE_STAFF_DESC: Looking to speed up the time it takes to salvage parts? Then you need another pair of hands. Remember, you're not just paying for an employee, you're paying for their time, their expertise, and the bribes for their parole officer.
SSS_TERMINUS: Meet the only heavyweight 4x4 on the market that didn't miss its anabolic window. If they drug tested cars, this thing's pee would melt the cup. Lucky for you, armor plating and slick mines aren't technically considered performance enhancing drugs, so have at 'em, champ.~n~~n~- Imani Tech upgrades available (Agency Vehicle Workshop)
SSS_DORADO: The Bison's older, weirder cousin that nobody wants to talk about, the Dorado got a bad rep with the wrong crowd in its formative years. Sure, it's had more meth stuffed in its crevices than a newly recruited member of the Lost MC, and it has the fuel efficiency of a bullet-riddled Youga. For the right demographic, those are some of its best features.
WTD_SNOWLNCHR: There's no greater gift than pummeling someone with rounds of festive cheer. With automatic reload, there's no time for anyone to disagree. Part of The Chop Shop.
WTD_BATTLERIFLE: Does life feel like a daily battle? Then why not try the Battle Rifle: the fast-acting pick-me-up that flawlessly targets every pain in your ass. Part of The Chop Shop.
CANDC_BENSON2: The dependable choice for transporting mouthwatering 110% meat, dead or alive. Potential buyers should be advised that the 110% smell is not an optional extra. It's an essential part of the brand.~n~~n~Please note: This is a Pegasus vehicle and cannot be stored in a personal garage.

LGM_SUZUME: Don't let the eye-watering acceleration or barely legal ground clearance fool you; the Suzume is a road-ready production car through and through. How Överflöd got it approved in Sweden is unclear, although suggestions that its total lack of safety features is an attempt to cull the population of epically stupid millionaires have been publicly denied by their marketing team, who recommend that you simply enjoy the thrill of reaching breakneck speeds in half a second with the absolute certainty that the slightest bump in the road will total you.~n~~n~- Missile Lock-On Jammer available
LGM_SENTINEL5: Let's not beat around the bush. We know our customer base. We know you. We know that bragging about the improved agility, the 6-speed transmission, the unparalleled clutch durability, or the diversity of torque outputs would only put you to sleep. So let us put it this way: with the Sentinel GTS, you'll be able to cut more people off, at greater speeds, under the influence of more narcotics, eluding more squad cars, making more headlines, and causing more collateral damage - all while giving less of a shit than ever before.~n~~n~- Missile Lock-On Jammer available
SSS_DRIFTL352: You'd probably be forgiven if you didn't immediately think "terrifying drift machine" when you saw this no-frills compact pick-up truck. There is no such thing as forgiveness, however, when some gibbering drift-nerd hits you with the driver-side door at 200mph on your roadside hike through Great Chaparral. But then, that particular douchebag saw the potential for a perfectly balanced jumble of physics-defying performance modifications that might, on a good day, not quite tear the chassis apart - and you didn't. So, lesson learned.~n~~n~- Missile Lock-On Jammer available~n~- Drift tuning built in (non-customizable)~n~~n~Please note: LS Car Meet Membership required for access to drift races.
LGM_EVERON3: We thought they couldn't do it. After the Karin engineers overstepped the mark with the last Everon model, unleashing a street truck so aggressive that it defied every known rule of automotive engineering and civic responsibility, they went ahead and outdid themselves. The RS takes the small-dick, big-ego energy of the last iteration, drops it down so close to the asphalt you'll need a barrel of silicone lube to get over the bump in your garage door, and amplifies its fuck-you styling to a level as obnoxious as the guy blasting reactionary country music on Vespucci Beach.~n~~n~- Missile Lock-On Jammer available
SSS_L352: Any proud Walton owner will know the sublime feeling of superiority that comes from literally sitting above everyone else. But sometimes our relentless narcissism demands that we feel more centered, more grounded, closer to the people. Enter the L35 Stock: providing the same feeling of undisguised supremacy, but with suspension that minimizes your ground-clearance and maximizes your chances of getting that elusive up-skirt picture of your ex-wife's mindfulness coach without violating the terms of your restraining order.~n~~n~- Missile Lock-On Jammer available
SUZU_WING_14: Sec. Carb. GT MK II Wing
CANDC_POLICEB2: Inflicting justice and perpetrating peace can be hot and heavy work, and sometimes you'd rather not be sweating your balls off behind the wheel of an LSPD cruiser. Hop on the classic Police Bike and allow the breeze of the Pacific to cool your neck and the refreshing smog of the city to fill your lungs. It also offers exceptional agility, whether you're conducting that unnecessary sobriety test on the hottie on Vespucci Boulevard or ignoring that armed robbery dispatch altogether.~n~~n~- Missile Lock-On Jammer available~n~- Dispatch Work available~n~- Purchase unlocks the exclusive Summer Highway Patrol outfit~n~~n~Please note: This vehicle can only be modified in properties you own and has a resale value of $0.
MINI_BUMR16: Carbon Heavy Duty w/ Sec. Trim
CANDC_STOCKADE4: They say never to take work home with you, but what about taking 30,000lb of it at high speed into the carpool lane on the freeway? Sure, Bobcat Security have taken a calculated PR risk by franchising their brand to any sociopath with an urgent need to transport large amounts of cash, assets, or human captives at high speed in a built-up environment, but if that's not a case study in the financial value of moving fast and breaking things, we don't know what is.~n~~n~Please note: This is a Pegasus vehicle and cannot be stored in a personal garage.
RAGT4_BUMF9: Winged Race w/ Sec. Trim Alt
SSS_MINIMUS: If you want to get as close to driving a people carrier as you can without completely giving up your hopes of ever having extramarital sex again, then boy oh boy is this the car for you. Equally equipped to chaperone little Tristan to his therapy session as it is to nimbly outmaneuver the LSPD as you violate 14 traffic laws en route to your next Hush Smush date, vehicular multitasking has never felt so 21st century.~n~~n~- Missile Lock-On Jammer available
SUZU_SPLIT_17: Bolt-On MK II w/ Sec. Trim
SSS_WOODLANDER: With the Woodlander you get to bring the rustic vibes of Paleto Forest on your journey, no matter where you're headed. Be it racing to your talent agent's office in Downtown before it's midday and they're too drunk to function, or crushing amphetamines to prepare for your seventh Vinewood audition of the morning, you can wind down your window, breathe in deeply, and smell the crisp pine, the musty earth, and the carcass of the coyote you flattened 5 miles back.~n~~n~- Missile Lock-On Jammer available~n~- HSW upgrades available (LS Car Meet, The Vinewood Club Garage, and Mansion Vehicle Workshops (GTA+))
SSS_HARDY: This teasing little hardbody debuted at the tail end of the 80s, edging a tantalizing line between standard commuter vehicle and screeching drift monster, yet never quite committing to either. Headed to another day at the office? Tearing down Vinewood Boulevard at noon with your fourth speedball of the day already dissolving in your eight cup of single-origin cold-brew? Whatever your pleasure, Annis' iconic 4-seater is guaranteed to get you Hardy.~n~~n~- Missile Lock-On Jammer available
SSS_TAMPA4: Dust off that old leather jacket, iron out those vintage Ranch jeans and crank Los Santos Rock Radio up to 11: you're about to become the final boss of mid-life crises. You weren't even alive when the Tampa GT came out, so no-one's going to believe that you blew what's left of your 401K for "nostalgia reasons", but with Vietnam-era rock blaring at full volume and a bored 19 year old staring at you with undisguised contempt in the passenger seat, who the hell cares?~n~~n~- Missile Lock-On Jammer available~n~- HSW upgrades available (LS Car Meet, The Vinewood Club Garage, and Mansion Vehicle Workshops (GTA+))
DL352_GRLL2: Matte Black w/ Sec. Light Tape
LGM_RAPIDGT4: Just when you think the Brits are finally going to come to terms with their newfound geopolitical irrelevance, they put out a banger like this, and the illusion limps on for another marketing cycle. With handling so good and responsiveness so intuitive that you won't know where your extremities end and machine begins, the Rapid GT X lets you play out your wildest biomechatronic fantasies on the open road, plus or minus any of the sexual stuff and/or the totally unjustified sense of entitlement. If that's your cup of milky tea.~n~~n~- Missile Lock-On Jammer available
LGM_CHEETAH3: Like putting chicken on a pizza or ketchup on a Bolognese, some parts of Italian culture are best left alone unless you're prepared to go to war. Luckily for you, the LSCM is willing to defend itself against the least effective military force in world history, all so we can bring you the only car ever to be considered an improvement on a base Grotti. Buon Appetito.~n~~n~- Car Meet showcase vehicle: unique bodykit with limited customization~n~- Missile Lock-On Jammer built in

PLRE_STYLE_DESC0: Perfect for subtle expressions of taste and nuanced statements of style, our sophisticated and muted pastel tints allow you to gently allude to a cohesive color scheme without ever having to properly commit to one.
PLRE_AI_DESC: A fully integrated AI system across all your mansions that balances its role as butler, personal assistant, and local entrepreneur.
PLRE_SECURITY_DESC: A private militia = peace of mind. Whether it's hostile takeovers or desperate Vinewood wannabes hoping for an industry leg-up, reduce the risk of your businesses being raided — or bolster existing businesses' security to eliminate the risk entirely — with a unit of highly stable and emotionally secure former special forces who won't hesitate to shoot on sight.
PLRE_AI_SUBHEADING: Every breath, every pause, every step in the dark, kept forever.
PLRE_OPTIONS_DESC0: While having a room dedicated to each of the 27 amendments would be technically possible in a house this size, the second comes as standard. Comes with a Mk II Weapon Workshop and a place to buy and modify a wide range of weapons.

LGM_FMJ2: Originally, this was meant to be a track-only prototype paying homage to a late 60s Vapid legend. Yet somewhere along the way, due to intense lobbying from low-esteem high net worth individuals, the MK V found its way into retail production and onto civilian streets. Sure, it won't look as good, feel as nice, or come even remotely close to reaching its full potential in your hands, but then again: when did anything?~n~~n~- Missile Lock-On Jammer available~n~- HSW upgrades available (LS Car Meet, The Vinewood Club Garage, and Mansion Vehicle Workshops (GTA+))
LGM_ITALI2: When you're inevitably facing the judge for causing a 50-vehicle pileup, surrounded by a jury of pitiful sedan drivers who can't even fathom what driving a 1980s Grotti icon feels like, you can take solace in the fact that, no matter what your sentence is, you were the most chic person to be pulled out of the smoking wreckage on the Los Santos freeway.~n~~n~- Missile Lock-On Jammer available
PLRE_OPTIONS_DESC3: As part of the Vinewood uber-elite, the only finger you should be lifting is the one to select which vehicle you'll upgrade, so enhance your car's cosmetics and performance without ever leaving the front door. GTA+ Members also have access to Benny's Original Motor Works, Hao's Special Works, Drift Tuning, and Missile Lock-On Jammer upgrades.
LGM_GT750: While many were lamenting the transition from the 1960s to the 1970s as the end of a counterculture era, the wizards at Grotti knew that what would truly restore cultural balance was a masterpiece of sports car engineering that remains the golden standard for stylish and sustainable high-speed travel.
